claims.source_quote: In 2023 sales increased $41 million in our space market due to accelerated activity on satellite avionics and components programs. ... The U.S. Department of Defense market is driven by governmental-authorized levels of defense spending, including funding for defense-related satellite technologies. ... Our launch vehicle and satellite components and systems, as well as our new space vehicle programs, will continue to benefit from increased investments in these markets.

claims.claim_text: Moog supplies missile steering controls and tactical/strategic missile defense controls; the tactical and strategic missile, missile defense and defense controls markets depend on DoD program funding levels.
claims.subject: Moog Space and Defense Controls
claims.object_value: Tactical and strategic missile / missile defense programs
claims.source_quote: Defense market - primary and secondary flight controls and components for military aircraft, turreted weapon systems, tactical and strategic missile steering controls and various defense product components. ... The tactical and strategic missile, missile defense and defense controls markets are dependent on many of the same market conditions as military aircraft, including overall military spending and program funding levels.

claims.claim_text: U.S. Government contracts represented 39% of Moog's total sales in FY2023, primarily within Aircraft Controls and Space and Defense Controls segments; sales to Boeing (commercial + defense) were 11% of FY2023 sales.
claims.subject: Moog Inc. (consolidated)
claims.object_value: U.S. Government 39% of FY2023 sales; Boeing 11% of FY2023 sales
claims.source_quote: In 2023, sales under U.S. Government contracts represented 39% of total sales and were primarily within our Aircraft Controls and Space and Defense Controls segments. ... We provide Boeing with controls for both military and commercial applications, as well as controls for space and defense applications, which totaled 11% of our 2023 sales.

claims.claim_text: Moog reports 12-month backlog of $2.4B at September 30, 2023 (up 4% YoY) and total backlog of $5.1B, with backlog increases driven by 'higher orders for both military and commercial OEM programs' in Aircraft Controls and across defense control / space vehicle programs in Space and Defense Controls.
claims.subject: Moog Inc. (consolidated)
claims.source_quote: Our twelve-month backlog as of September 30, 2023 was $2.4 billion ... total backlog was $5.1 billion ... The twelve-month backlog also increased in Space and Defense Controls across our defense control programs as well as our space vehicle programs.
